findings.highlight: She boasts superhuman speed, but she's being forced back by Saber's counterattacks.
findings.evidenceJa: ……超人的なスピードを誇る彼女だからこそ、セイバーの反撃を受けつつ離脱できる。
findings.governingReading: Only her superhuman speed enables her to disengage despite receiving Saber's counterattacks.
findings.explanation: Speed enabling disengagement becomes speed contrasted with forced retreat.

findings.highlight: Any of Saber's injuries are automatically healed.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーによって傷つけられた体を癒す自然治癒。
findings.governingReading: Rider spends resources on natural healing of body wounded by Saber.
findings.explanation: Rider's injuries inflicted by Saber become Saber's injuries healing.

findings.governingReading: Rider gives no thought to afterward while burning all resources to contain Saber.
findings.explanation: Ignoring future cost becomes foregone outcome.

findings.highlight: Rider keeps attacking, while Saber stops her with attacks of her own.
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーは攻め続ける事で、セイバーの攻撃を防いでいる。
findings.governingReading: Rider keeps attacking in order to prevent Saber taking initiative; if Saber attacks both Rider and boy die immediately.
findings.explanation: Offense preventing Saber attack becomes Saber stopping Rider with attacks.

findings.highlight: No, in this moment, every part of my body is dead.
findings.evidenceJa: いや、この瞬間、体のいたるところが死んでいる。
findings.governingReading: At this moment portions throughout his body are dying, in ongoing erasure.
findings.explanation: Dying throughout body becomes every part already dead.

findings.governingReading: Because Rider fights desperately for him, boy says he cannot offer complaints and must fight by his own means.
findings.explanation: Boy cannot complain becomes Rider is not whining.

findings.highlight: My right lung is torn out from inside.
findings.evidenceJa: 右の肺が、内側から切り裂かれた。
findings.governingReading: Right lung is cut or torn open from within.
findings.explanation: Right lung cut open becomes torn out.
